defs.def: a thing that is added to sth else to improve or complete it 增补（物）；补充（物）；添加物

ex.s: Meanwhile, scientists are working on energy-saving measures and new fuel sources to supplement oil supplies.
ex.t: 与此同时，科学家们正在研究节能措施和新的燃料来源，以补充石油供应。

defs.def: an extra separate section, often in the form of a magazine, that is sold with a newspaper （报纸的）增刊
a book or a section at the end of a book that gives extra information or deals with a special subject （书籍的）补编，补遗，附录
an amount of money that you pay for an extra service or item, especially in addition to the basic cost of a holiday/vacation 额外费用，附加费（尤指度假服务的）

chunks.cn: 燃料 来源 去 增补
